title: RBI bank housing credit outstanding

source.title: Handbook of Statistics on Indian Economy — Table 45: Sectoral Deployment of Non-Food Gross Bank Credit

methodology: Figures are the published March outstanding amounts for bank credit to housing. Values since July 2023 include the impact of a non-bank merger; RBI's ex-merger figures are shown separately in the notes.

metrics.name: Housing credit outstanding (including priority sector housing)
metrics.definition: Gross bank credit outstanding to housing as on the last reporting Friday in March, published by RBI in INR crore.

metrics.name: Priority-sector housing outstanding (memo)
metrics.definition: Memo item within RBI's sectoral deployment table, distinct from the total housing line.

notes: RBI evidence: '4.2 Housing (Including Priority Sector Housing) 1492302 1738473 1991164 2718715 3010477' and '5.4 Housing 578081 617927 622889 755222 746651'.
Figures in parentheses in the RBI table exclude the merger impact: 23,31,935 / 26,89,068 for total housing and 6,60,572 / 6,65,107 for priority-sector housing for the last two periods.
RBI does not publish an annual bank home-loan disbursement series in this table. No disbursement value is substituted.
